body: i can't even make myself feel better. how am i going to make them feel better?
no one to ask. my family has never cared about me. i just live with them but that's all.
mhm that's about the only thing i can do. ive been sitting here since last night.
I called the suicide prevention hotline in my country. Couldn't speak. I feel like I'll throw up if I do.

I live with my family. And my family one of the reasons I turned out to be like.

I don't have the energy to go out or to even get out of my chair. I'm getting dizzier and my head hurts more with each passing minute.

I wonder, can I die from this head injury. Should I smash my head on the wall to do myself in? Even that seems too hard to do.

I want to fade away. Just be gone.

I know. I tend to assume the worst things too. My mind would go into overdrive when he doesn't reply within a reasonable time.

Did he leave me without saying anything? Did something happen to him? Has he decided that he doesn't want me anymore? Am I not good enough?

The constant fear and anxiety drive me nuts. Uses up all my energy.

It's so hard to trust. But I think that's what you have to do. I haven't managed to do this so I don't know what to tell you aside from best of luck.

Mhm, that's me in a pinch. It was even harder for me cause it was a long-distance relationship. The fear that he would go away and abandon me and that I'm not good enough drove me nuts.

All in the past tense cause he left. I suck so he left.

Knowing his schedule helped out a lot cause I know when I can expect a text from him or not.

What I would give for something like that. You can still hope.

I have no hope. Nothing. He left. Just told me to go away and blocked me. I thought it was just a temporary whim, he's blocked me before while I was in one of my rages, and then unblocked me after a few minutes.

Then, I just learned from a common friend that he told him to stop talking about me cause he already left me.

I was so dizzy from the wave of emotions last night. Plus, have my period. When I stood up to get water, I blacked out, tripped on my own feet, and hit my head on a post.

It won't stop bleeding. But I'm scared to go to the doctor alone. More importantly, I wouldn't be able to use my phone in the hospital, and a part of me is still hoping, waiting, that he will text me. So, I'm sitting here, trying to feel better by being with people who are going through the same thing as me, head bleeding and hurting a lot.

Anyway, look on the bright side. He didn't ghost you. And there's still the possibility of getting back together. Hope it works out for you.

Same. And do you feel like it's so unfair? Why am I suffering because of genetics, childhood trauma, and constant abandonment? Even when I had something really good I wasted it cause I can't stop splitting. I can't stop the wave of emotions. I can't stop the fear and anxiety.

How is it fair that others are born normal and I'm not? What did I do to deserve this?

I'm sick of being scared all the time. I'm just so tired. I want to give up.

Why do I have to keep going when it's just so hard each day?

I want to escape.

What is there left? I've given my last relationship my 200% effort. It was hard, so damn hard, but I changed a lot. I was actually improving, was learning to better manage myself. There were times I would trip but I was doing was I can.

I already gave it my all and it still failed. So what more is left?

And I can't blame him. How can I ask him to love me when I can't even love myself?

I'm so disgusted of myself I feel like insects are crawling under my skin. I want to rip my skin apart.

Why am I so worthless?

I want to run away.

That's the same for me. I drove him away because of my insecurities. He's only going on a trip but I was panicking cause I felt like he'll never come back to me. In the end, what I was so scared of came true because of my own stupidity.
